title: Procopius of Gaza, Letters (Ἐπιστολαί), about 162–166 letters / Прокопий Газский, Письма
author: Procopius of Gaza
genre: Literary epistolography (friendship, patronage and school letters)
size: About 166 letters; about 25,000 Greek words (my estimate from the OCR of Hercher's text)
edition: Garzya & Loenertz 1963 (Ettal). Public domain: Hercher, Epistolographi Graeci (1873), archive.org/details/epistolographoih00hercuoft. Italian edition: Amato et al. 2010.
ru_evidence: Russian Wikipedia 'Прокопий Газский' lists works and modern editions but no Russian translation. None on Myriobiblion, the Russian Byzantine-texts library.
en_evidence: No scholarly English found (BMCR reviews mention only Italian and French work). romanletters.org (2026) has unvetted Claude-made English of all 166 letters, labelled non-authoritative.
other_translations: Italian: F. Ciccolella in E. Amato (ed.), Rose di Gaza (2010), BMCR 2011.10.10. The French Budé volume (2014) covers the rhetorical works, not the letters (BMCR 2015.03.48).
value: Core of the 'School of Gaza': a network of sophists, bishops, officials and pupils in Palestine around 500. Key for late antique education, Christian–classical paideia and prosopography. The short letters suit a bilingual, annotated scholarly edition.
ai_feasibility: High. Short, formulaic Atticist letters. Main risks are allusions and identifying addressees (PLRE), so the commentary needs expert prosopographical checking.
